tools.name: browse_hub
tools.description: Browse the JellyWatch Community Hub — a directory of Jellyfin and Emby plugins, themes, clients, and tools. Use filter to sort by popularity, recency, or views.

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any public JellyWatch page as clean Markdown. Supports: / (homepage), /about, /privacy, /glossary, /status, /blog (listing), /blog/{slug} (article), /doc/{slug} (docs), /hub (community hub listing), /hub/{slug} (plugin detail).

tools.name: get_site_index
tools.description: Get the complete JellyWatch site index (llms.txt format). Lists all public pages, app features, blog articles, and community hub projects.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search JellyWatch blog articles by keyword. Returns matching posts as Markdown with titles, summaries, and URLs.
